decisions.reason: A newly launched handle family in a durable architectural hardware range with long product lifecycles is very unlikely to be withdrawn after one year.
The mitred handle family complements the coordinated design range, and its tooling investment argues for keeping it on the market.
A multifunctional lever fits the firm's barrier-free and system-solution strategy, so an early withdrawal is improbable.
A recent door lever line in a premium, planner-specified range typically stays on the market for many years.
The award-winning FSB 1289 collection has its own page and design recognition, making it a flagship to keep.
